phase: 9A — Play Lobby, activation clarity, multi-position placement

results.name: registry version carries the route model
seven modes, each with id, label, route, category, one sentence, status inputs
mode routes are unique and not the lobby
Chaos Clash, Dream Matchup, Daily Clash are primary, in order
Best of 7, Win 82, Tournament, Era Gauntlet are secondary, in order
Chaos Clash alone is recommended and supports continuation
every status has a label decision and an action word
statuses reachable in this build are the truthful five
no mode is behind a subscription for any tier
Coming soon never routes to checkout
a locked (account) mode routes to its own address, where the gate is
requiresAccount is derived from the entitlement matrix
the trial pairing in entitlements agrees with the registry
entitlements no longer defines a mode list
the header, the lobby and the App read the registry and define no mode list
Fantasy is a top-level pillar, not a play mode
every mode route resolves back to its mode

registry.label: Chaos Clash
registry.shortDescription: Three rolls. Hold your legends. Adapt to the era.
registry.implementationNote: Built. A server-authoritative three-roll draft on /api/game; a guest has three runs, a free account has unlimited.

registry.label: Dream Matchup
registry.implementationNote: Built. The manual builder with multi-position placement; a free account is asked for while Chaos Clash is the free default.

registry.label: Daily Clash
registry.implementationNote: Built. Server-seeded; one official attempt per day.

registry.label: Best of 7
registry.implementationNote: Built. Opens on a free account through its trial capability; runs on the production engine.

registry.label: Win 82
registry.implementationNote: Built as a preview on a free account through its trial capability.

registry.label: Tournament
registry.implementationNote: Built. Joining needs a free account; creating a private bracket is a commissioner capability.

registry.label: Era Gauntlet
registry.implementationNote: Not built. Specified; flagged off; its card opens the information page and never a checkout.

statusMapping.note: The specification names PLUS_REQUIRED and PREVIEW_DISABLED; the repository's registry predates it with SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED and DISABLED_FOR_PREVIEW, which the tests and e2e already pin. The names are kept; the meaning is the same. UNAVAILABLE_HERE is new: the server has a mode switched off in this deployment.
